video_title: We went to BATTLE with the Sixers

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid's effective pick-and-roll game
quotes.excerpt: Maxey and Embiid, it's a pretty good pick-and-roll.
quotes.quote: They're probably doing something similar to the Lakers game when we watched that one where high pick-and-roll with Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid. It's a pretty good pick-and-roll.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Explaining the 'ice coverage' defensive strategy against Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: We call this in the NBA, this is called an ice coverage.
quotes.quote: This is called an ice coverage. Joel Embiid is forcing the ball to the sideline. He's trying to keep the ball on the sideline and Embiid is going into a deep drop. We call this in the NBA, this is called an ice coverage. Nikola Vucevic, I haven't seen this yet but I'm assuming as I take a dribble Vucevic is going to pop here.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive challenges of an open-side pick-and-roll
quotes.excerpt: In this instance, because it's an open side and a clear side pick-and-roll, it means all three guys are on the weak side.
quotes.quote: In this instance, because it's an open side and a clear side pick-and-roll, it means all three guys are on the weak side. So you see Joel Embiid, Jared McCain, and Kelly Oubre Jr. are all on the weak side of the floor. It means it's open side, so I'm trying to be the help man here.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Defending Joel Embiid in the mid-range area
quotes.excerpt: When you force a post player that's really good on the low block to catch it in the mid-range.
quotes.quote: When you force a post player that's really good on the low block to catch it in the mid-range. And Joel Embiid is a very, very good player in any position on the floor, whether it's the block or in the mid-range. But this allows you to have more resistance because if you catch it at the block, he's one dribble and he's probably going to be at the front of the rim.

quotes.speaker: Josh Giddey
quotes.summary_phrase: Need for better defensive positioning against Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: I probably got to do a better job of taking away the middle of the floor.
quotes.quote: I probably got to do a better job of taking away the middle of the floor. If you see me on the ball here, I've probably got to be standing directly in front of Joel Embiid where that hash mark is to take away anything to the top of the key and make him throw it, you know, either into the backcourt or somewhere else other than the top of the key.
